name: spatial/ambient-background
title: WebGL ambient background
description: A slow contour field behind the page.

files.content:
export { AmbientBackground } from './AmbientBackground';
export type { AmbientBackgroundProps } from './AmbientBackground';

notes: Decorative: hidden from assistive technology and ignores pointer events.
Never required: where WebGPU and WebGL2 are both missing, or loading fails, a static CSS contour pattern is shown instead.
Pauses when off screen or when the tab is hidden, and holds one still frame under reduced motion.
The pixel ratio is capped at 1.5 to limit GPU work on high-density screens.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Draws a single still frame of the field.
